title: Cardiovascular Kidney and Metabolic Health Assessment and Patient Empowerment

summary: The primary objective of CHAPERONE solution is to evaluate the efficacy of engaging, assessing, and enabling long term treatment strategy with Health Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chatbot, Copilot, Large Language Model (LLM) and vital sign monitoring device in reducing CKM disease burden using an algorithm obtained from biomarkers and diagnostics utilizing remote sensor driven technology tools, care coordination and patient empowerment.
